import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int N;
    static ModInt[][] probability = new ModInt[7][7];

    static class ModInt {
        int val;

        ModInt(long v) {
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            this.val = (int) v;
        }

        static int modInv(int a, int m) {
            int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;
            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                int tmp = g % r;
                g = r;
                r = tmp;
                int tmpX = x - q * y;
                x = y;
                y = tmpX;
            }
            return x < 0 ? x + m : x;
        }

        ModInt add(ModInt other) {
            int res = this.val + other.val;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        ModInt subtract(ModInt other) {
            int res = this.val - other.val;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        ModInt multiply(ModInt other) {
            long res = (long) this.val * other.val;
            res %= MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        ModInt divide(ModInt other) {
            return this.multiply(other.inv());
        }

        ModInt inv() {
            return new ModInt(modInv(this.val, MOD));
        }

        ModInt pow(long p) {
            assert p >= 0;
            ModInt result = new ModInt(1);
            ModInt base = new ModInt(this.val);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) {
                    result = result.multiply(base);
                }
                base = base.multiply(base);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Integer.toString(val);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(parts[j]);
                probability[i][j] = new ModInt(p).divide(new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> masksWithCount = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            masksWithCount.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        int[] lookup = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(lookup, -1);

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
            int count = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            lookup[mask] = masksWithCount.get(count).size();
            masksWithCount.get(count).add(mask);
        }

        Map<Long, ModInt> possibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
        possibleMasks.put(1L << lookup[0], new ModInt(1));

        for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
            Map<Long, ModInt> newPossibleMasks = new HashMap<>();

            for (int current = 0; current < (1 << N); current++) {
                ModInt product = new ModInt(1);
                for (int right = 0; right < N; right++) {
                    boolean bitSet = ((current >> right) & 1) != 0;
                    if (bitSet) {
                        product = product.multiply(probability[left][right]);
                    } else {
                        ModInt oneMinus = new ModInt(1).subtract(probability[left][right]);
                        product = product.multiply(oneMinus);
                    }
                }

                for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> p : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
                    long possible = p.getKey();
                    ModInt prob = p.getValue();

                    long newPossible = 0;
                    for (int mask : masksWithCount.get(left)) {
                        if (((possible >> lookup[mask]) & 1) != 0) {
                            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                                boolean currentBit = ((current >> i) & 1) != 0;
                                boolean maskBit = ((mask >> i) & 1) != 0;
                                if (currentBit && !maskBit) {
                                    long newMask = mask | (1 << i);
                                    newPossible |= 1L << lookup[(int) newMask];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    newPossibleMasks.put(newPossible, newPossibleMasks.getOrDefault(newPossible, new ModInt(0)).add(prob.multiply(product)));
                }
            }
            possibleMasks = newPossibleMasks;
        }

        ModInt answer = new ModInt(0);
        long fullMask = (1L << N) - 1;
        int lastIndex = lookup[(int) fullMask];
        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> p : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
            if (((p.getKey() >> lastIndex) & 1) != 0) {
                answer = answer.add(p.getValue());
            }
        }

        System.out.println(answer.val);
    }
}
